Rabies vaccine vials flagged as substandard by government lab

A government laboratory has flagged rabies vaccine vials found at an unauthorized site in Delhi as substandard and misbranded. The manufacturer of the vaccine, Abhayrab, stated that the flagged vials are not their products and that legitimate batches undergo extensive testing. The drug regulator has flagged the mainstream rabies vaccine Abhayrab following the discovery.
